readings.title: The Command to Cross the Yarděn
readings.subtitle: YeHoVaH's Charge to Be Strong and Courageous
readings.text: [Joshua 1:1] And it came to be, after the death of Mosheh the servant of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, that <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke to Yehoshua son of Nun, the assistant of Mosheh, saying, [2] <dq>Mosheh <dn>My</dn> servant is dead, so now, arise, pass over <dn>את</dn> this Yarděn, you and all this people, to the land which <dn>I</dn> am giving to them, to the children of Yisra’ěl.</dq> [3] <dq>Every place on which the sole of your foot treads <dn>I</dn> have given you, as <dn>I</dn> spoke to Mosheh.</dq> [4] <dq>From the wilderness and this Leḇanon even as far as the great river, the River Euphrates, all the land of the Ḥittites, and to the Great Sea toward the going down of the sun, is your border.</dq> [5] <dq>No man is going to stand before you all the days of your life. As <dn>I</dn> was with Mosheh, so <dn>I</dn> am with you. <dn>I</dn> do not fail you nor forsake you.</dq> [6] <dq>Be strong and courageous, for you are to let <dn>את</dn> this people inherit <dn>את</dn> the land which <dn>I</dn> swore to their fathers to give them.</dq> [7] <dq>Only be strong and very courageous, to guard to do according to all the Torah which Mosheh <dn>My</dn> servant commanded you. Do not turn from it right or left, so that you act wisely wherever you go.</dq> [8] <dq>Do not let this Book of the Torah depart from your mouth, but you shall meditate on it day and night, so that you guard to do according to all that is written in it. For then you shall make <dn>את</dn> your way prosperous, and act wisely.</dq> [9] <dq>Have <dn>I</dn> not commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Do not be afraid, nor be discouraged, for <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> is with you wherever you go.</dq>

readings.title: Preparing the Camp
readings.subtitle: The Transjordan Tribes Reminded of Their Vow
readings.text: [Joshua 1:10] And Yehoshua commanded <dn>את</dn> the officers of the people, saying, [11] “Pass through the midst of the camp and command <dn>את</dn> the people, saying, ‘Prepare food for yourselves, for within three days you are passing over <dn>את</dn> this Yarděn, to go in to possess <dn>את</dn> the land which <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> is giving you to possess.’ ” [12] And Yehoshua spoke to the Re’uḇěnites and to the Gaḏites and to half the tribe of Menashsheh, saying, [13] “Remember <dn>את</dn> the word which Mosheh, servant of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, commanded <dn>את</dn> you, saying, ‘<dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> is giving you rest, and <dn>He</dn> shall give you <dn>את</dn> this land.’ [14] “Let your wives, your little ones, and your livestock stay in the land which Mosheh gave you beyond the Yarděn. But you shall pass before your brothers in fives, all your brave fighters, and shall help <dn>את</dn> them, [15] until <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> has given your brothers rest, as unto you. So shall they also take possession of <dn>את</dn> the land which <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> is giving them. Then you shall return to the land of your possession, and shall possess <dn>את</dn> that which Mosheh the servant of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> gave you beyond the Yarděn toward the rising of the sun.” [16] And they answered <dn>את</dn> Yehoshua, saying, “All that you have commanded us we do, and wherever you send us we go. [17] “According to all that we obeyed Mosheh, so we obey you. Only, let <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn> be with you, as <dn>He</dn> was with Mosheh. [18] “Whoever rebels against <dn>את</dn> your mouth and does not obey <dn>את</dn> your words, in all that you command him, is put to death. Only be strong and courageous.”

readings.title: The Mission to Yeriḥo
readings.subtitle: Raḥaḇ Hides the Spies
readings.text: [Joshua 2:1] And Yehoshua son of Nun secretly sent out two men from Shittim to spy, saying, “Go, see <dn>את</dn> the land, and <dn>את</dn> Yeriḥo.” And they went, and came to the house of a woman, a whore, and her name was Raḥaḇ, and they lay down there. [2] But it was reported to the sovereign of Yeriḥo, saying, “See, men from the children of Yisra’ěl have come here tonight to search out <dn>את</dn> the land.” [3] And the sovereign of Yeriḥo sent to Raḥaḇ, saying, “Bring out the men who have come to you, who have entered your house, for they have come to search out <dn>את</dn> all the land.” [4] But the woman had taken <dn>את</dn> the two men and hid them. So she said, “The men came to me, but I did not know where they were from. [5] “Then it came to be as the gate was being shut, when it was dark, that the men went out. I do not know where the men went. Pursue them quickly, so that you overtake them.” [6] But she had brought them up to the roof and hidden them with the stalks of flax, which she had laid out on the roof. [7] And the men pursued them by the way to the Yarděn, to the fords. And they shut the gate afterwards as soon as the pursuers had gone out.

readings.title: The Scarlet Cord
readings.subtitle: The Oath of Loving-Commitment
readings.text: [Joshua 2:8] And before they lay down, she came up to them on the roof, [9] and she said to the men, “I know that <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> has given you <dn>את</dn> the land, and that the fear of you has fallen on us, and that all the inhabitants of the land melt away because of you. [10] “For we have heard <dn>את</dn> how <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> dried up <dn>את</dn> the water of the Sea of Reeds for you when you came out of Mitsrayim, and what you did to the two sovereigns of the Amorites who were beyond the Yarděn, Siḥon and Oḡ, whom you put <dn>את</dn> under the ban. [11] “And when we heard, our hearts melted, and there was no spirit left in anyone because of you, for <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> your <dn>Elohim</dn>, <dn>He</dn> is <dn>Elohim</dn> in the heavens above and on earth beneath. [12] “And now, please swear to me by <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, since I have shown you loving-commitment, that you also show loving-commitment to my father’s house, and shall give me a true token, [13] and shall spare <dn>את</dn> my father, and <dn>את</dn> my mother, and <dn>את</dn> my brothers, and <dn>את</dn> my sisters, and <dn>את</dn> all that they have, and shall deliver <dn>את</dn> our lives from death.” [14] And the men said to her, “Our lives for yours, if you do not expose <dn>את</dn> this matter of ours, then it shall be, when <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> has given us <dn>את</dn> the land, that we shall treat you in loving-commitment and truth.” [15] So she let them down by a rope through the window, for her house was on the city wall and she dwelt on the wall. [16] And she said to them, “Go to the mountain, lest the pursuers come upon you. And you shall hide there three days, until the pursuers have returned, and afterwards go on your way.” [17] And the men said to her, “We are released from this oath of yours which you have made us swear, [18] unless, when we come into the land, you bind <dn>את</dn> this line of scarlet cord in the window through which you let us down, and unless you bring <dn>את</dn> your father, and <dn>את</dn> your mother, and <dn>את</dn> your brothers, and <dn>את</dn> all your father’s household to your own home. [19] “And it shall be that anyone who goes outside the doors of your house into the street, his blood is on his own head, and we are innocent. And anyone who is with <dn>את</dn> you in the house, his blood is on our head if a hand is laid on him. [20] “And if you expose <dn>את</dn> this matter of ours, then we shall be released from your oath which you made us swear.” [21] And she said, “Let it be according to your words.” And she sent them away, and they went. And she bound <dn>את</dn> the scarlet cord in the window. [22] So they left and came to the mountain, and stayed there three days until the pursuers returned. And the pursuers sought them in all the way, but did not find them. [23] Then the two men returned and came down from the mountain, and passed over. And they came to Yehoshua son of Nun, and related to him <dn>את</dn> all that had befallen them. [24] And they said to Yehoshua, “Truly <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> has given <dn>את</dn> all the land into our hands, and also, all the inhabitants of the land have melted away because of us.”
